description: This file contains CMake functions and macros related to building and configuring project targets, including linking libraries, compile options, include directories, and generating configuration files for package and find modules.

methods.name: add_element
methods.description: Appends an element to a list variable.

methods.name: _get_default_link_name
methods.description: Derives a default link name and directory from a library path.

methods.name: get_if_link_libraries
methods.description: Retrieves link libraries and directories for a target, resolving imported and local targets, and their dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_defines
methods.description: Collects compile definitions for a target including interface and target-specific ones.

methods.name: get_if_compile_options
methods.description: Collects compile options for a target including interface and target-specific ones.

methods.name: get_if_include_dirs
methods.description: Collects include directories for a target, resolving interface and local targets.

methods.name: InstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a CMake configuration file for a target, supporting dependencies and templates.

methods.name: InstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a pkg-config (.pc) file for a target, including compile options, defines, and include paths.

methods.name: InstallFindModule
methods.description: Installs CMake find modules (*.cmake files) from a specified directory or files.

methods.name: print_properties
methods.description: Prints all properties supported by CMake, as listed by 'cmake --help-property-list'.

methods.name: print_target_properties
methods.description: Prints all properties of a specified target.

methods.name: semicolon_safe_string
methods.description: Escapes semicolons in a string, replacing them with ASCII 31 characters.

methods.name: InstallCompatibleCMakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a compatible interface library target for legacy include and header configuration, suitable for distribution.
